neighbours.label: the token ' m', '-m' or '_m': a separator glued to the first letter of a word beginning with m ('force| m|ajeure', 'Sauvez|-m|oi', 'scale|_m|ri', 'upper| m|olar')
fire: A clause on force majeure protects the shipping firm.
Our dentist pulled a lower molar from his jaw.
Each party may cite force majeure under this contract.
She mowed the lawn before the rain started.
That upper molar hurts when I drink cold water.
Donne-moi le sel, s'il te plaît.
quiet: A clause on late fees protects the shipping firm.
Our dentist cleaned a lower tooth in his jaw.
Each party may cite these rules under this contract.
She raked the lawn before the rain started.
That upper tooth hurts when I drink cold water.
Donne-lui le sel, s'il te plaît.

notes: Card: ' m' x9, '-m' x5, ' м' x5, '_m' x3, ' M' x2, ' М'. Probe: ' m' of majeure 0.759; '-m' of moi 0.386; ' upper' before molar 0.280; '_mri' at the start of a line 0.023; 'Moksha' sentence 0.007; '-n' of nous 0.009. Tokenizer splits checked. Near misses have other first letters.
